title: Horrible - do not download. It’s a scam
body: The app features are confusing. Paid 1€ for a three day trial, then got charge 29,99 €. The subscription did not appear in my App Store and it doesn’t appear like that on my bank account either. I deleted the app after one day now I cannot even login to see my account as it wants to charge me again. When I click the “restore payments” option it won’t restore my account. I contacted my bank and they said it was a scam.
author: Pipp89
